Misplaced your card? Use Citi® Quick Lock in the Citi Mobile® App or at citi.com to instantly block new charges while allowing recurring transactions to continue without disruption.
24-hour fraud protection
Citi will alert you if we see unusual activity on your account.
Mastercard® ID Theft Protection
The ID Theft Protection program offered by Mastercard® helps eliminate the worry of identity theft by monitoring the information you choose to protect and alerting you if suspicious activity is found. It takes just a few minutes to enroll for free, and as soon as you do, your monitoring begins. Visit mastercardidps.idprotectiononline.com to learn more.
Contactless pay
Shop safely with a contactless chip-enabled card. Just tap your card on the payment reader and go in seconds.Card managementAutomatic account alerts
Stay updated on balance, payments and credit limits via email or text.
Choose your payment due date
Choose to pay your bill on any available due date in the beginning, middle or end of the month. Enjoy the flexibility of paying your full balance or just the minimum payment due each month.
Paperless statements and e-communications
Reduce clutter and get your statements and most legal notices online instead of in the mail.
Add an Authorized User
Add an Authorized User to your account at no additional cost and earn points faster.
24/7 Customer Service
To save time and manage your account from anywhere, download the Citi Mobile® App. You can handle most of your banking needs right from your phone, 24/7.ConvenienceCiti Mobile® App
Manage your account when you want, where you want and the way you want. It's how Citi digital services help you get the most out of your time.
Digital wallets
Digital wallets let you shop with confidence in millions of places online, within apps and in stores. With digital wallets you can speed through checkout and continue to enjoy all the great benefits that come with your card. Learn how to get started and how digital wallets can help protect your card information at citi.com/digitalservices.
Access FICO® Score
Get free access to your FICO® Score online to review your credit history.LifestyleCiti Entertainment®
Citi Entertainment® is an entertainment access program available to eligible Citi® credit card and Citibank® Debit Card customers. Citi cardmembers get special access to purchase tickets to thousands of events, including presale tickets and exclusive experiences to the year's most anticipated concerts, sporting events, arts and culture experiences. To learn more, visit citientertainment.com.
Citi Travel®
With Citi Travel®, you can book flights, hotels, car rentals and attractions using your eligible Citi card, points or a combination of both. Citi Travel offers access to over 1.4 million hotels and resorts available worldwide.
Points transfer
Points transfer to American Airlines, JetBlue, Virgin Atlantic, Cathay, Eva Air, Choice Hotels, The Leading Hotels of the World® and others. The minimum transfer is only 1,000 points.
Citi® Flex Pay
Buy now, pay later with Citi® Flex Pay. Pay over time in fixed monthly payments and continue to earn points on purchases. Available on eligible purchases of $75 or more.2Explore the family of Strata CardsDiscover a range of credit cards tailored to your passions and priorities. Explore our collection of Citi Strata Credit Cards. Learn more FAQsWhat are the benefits of the Citi Strata® Card?
The Citi Strata® Card offers several benefits, including the ability to earn points to redeem for great rewards through the ThankYou® Rewards program:
5X points on Hotels, Car Rentals, and Attractions booked through cititravel.com
3X points at Supermarkets2
3X points on Select Transit and at Gas & EV Charging Stations2
3X points on an eligible Self-Select Category of your choice. Self-Select Categories include: Fitness Clubs, Select Streaming Services, Live Entertainment, Cosmetic Stores/Barber Shops/Hair Salons, or Pet Supply Stores.2
2X points at Restaurants2
1X points on All Other Purchases2
The Citi Strata® Card also comes with a low intro APR offer for new cardholders.
Is there an Annual Fee for the Citi Strata® Card?There is no Annual Fee.1How does the Self-Select Category work?
You will earn 3X ThankYou Points for each $1 spent on purchases made in an eligible Self-Select Category of your choice. Self-Select Categories include: Fitness Clubs, Select Streaming Services, Live Entertainment, Cosmetic Stores/Barber Shops/Hair Salons, or Pet Supply Stores.
When your account is opened, the default Self-Select Category is Select Streaming Services. To change your Self-Select Category the primary card member must register for an online account and sign-in at citi.com/selfselect or call 1-800-842-6596 (TTY: We accept 711 or other Relay Service) and choose which Self-Select Category to activate. You may change your Self-Select Category once each calendar quarter (January – March, April – June, July – September, October – December). The change will go into effect the following day at 12 AM CT.
Are there any bonus offers available for the Citi Strata® Card?Visit the Citi Strata® Card page to view the latest bonus offer as any available bonus offers for the Citi Strata® Card can change from time to time.Is the Citi Strata® Card a Mastercard® or Visa® Credit Card?The Citi Strata® Card is a Mastercard®.How do you redeem ThankYou® Points with the Citi Strata® Card?
You can easily redeem ThankYou® Points for your Citi Strata® Card online or by calling the ThankYou Service Center. You can also use ThankYou Points for travel at cititravel.com.
If you choose to redeem online, visit thankyou.com to view the entire rewards collection available through the ThankYou® Rewards program. Upon login, there are several ways you can browse and redeem for rewards:
The main Rewards page presents all categories. Simply select the type of reward you're interested in to see what the collection has to offer.
Browse by specific points ranges.
Use the search tool to find specific items in the collection.
Add any desired item to your cart. After your order has been placed, a confirmation email will be sent to confirm that the redemption was successful.
If you choose to redeem points by calling the ThankYou Service Center at 1-800-THANKYOU (1-800-842-6596), please note that only select items are redeemable by phone. For speech or hearing impaired TTY: We accept 711 or other Relay Service.
What credit score is needed to qualify for the Citi Strata® Card?There are many factors that Citi uses to determine creditworthiness, including your credit score. You can always visit Citi's Credit Card homepage and navigate to the pre-qualify section to see which type of Citi card you may be pre-qualified for without affecting your credit score.Citi Strata® CardEarn 20,000 bonus pointsafter spending $1,000 in the first 3 months2 Apply now 1Important Pricing & Information +2Additional Information +1Citi Strata® Card Pricing Details0% Intro APR for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers from date of account opening; after that, the variable APR for unpaid promotional balances, new purchases, and new balance transfers is 18.74% - 28.74%, based on your creditworthiness. For Citi Flex Plans subject to an APR, the variable APR is 18.74% - 28.74%, based on creditworthiness. For Citi Flex Pay Plans subject to a Plan Fee, a monthly fee of up to 1.72% will apply, based on the Citi Flex Plan duration, the APR that would otherwise apply to the Transaction, and other factors. The variable APR for cash advances is 29.99%. The variable penalty APR is up to 29.99% and may be applied if you make a late payment or make a payment that is returned. Minimum interest charge – $0.50. Annual fee - $0. Fee for foreign purchases - 3% of the U.S. dollar amount of each purchase. Cash advance fee - either $10 or 5% of the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater. Balance transfer fee — intro fee of 3% of each transfer ($5 minimum) completed within the first 4 months of account opening. After that, 5% of each transfer ($5 minimum).
